name: handoff
description: One-click compact or handoff to a new session once the context passes a threshold, with summaries saved to disk

thresholdK.title: Show the buttons from (k tokens)
thresholdK.description: The handoff buttons appear above the prompt once the context holds this many thousand tokens. Default 200; enter 0 to reset to it, as the settings page cannot clear a field. /handoff works at any size.

compactFirst.title: New session: compact the old one first
compactFirst.description: Compacts the old session before starting the new one, so resuming it later loads from the summary. Turned off, the summary is written without changing the old session.

folder.title: Folder for saved summaries
folder.description: Where each handoff summary is saved, one file per handoff. ~ means your home folder.
